verdict.rationale: Legacy OTP support (TOTP/HOTP slots or challenge-response) is a fair question for a hardware security key, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents only FIDO/U2F (CTAP1) and passkey use, with no mention of OTP slots or challenge-response modes.

support.subject: As a power user, the key covers legacy one-time-password schemes — TOTP/HOTP slots or challenge-response — for services that still lack WebAuthn
